scenario.en: A free Sunday morning. You usually…
scenario.id: Minggu pagi yg kosong. Kamu biasanya…

answers.en: Have activity ideas ready from last night ✨
answers.id: Udah siapin ide aktivitas dr semalam ✨

answers.en: See how the morning feels, then decide 🍃
answers.id: Lihat mood pagi ini, baru tentuin 🍃

scenario.en: A family day out. How do you pack?
scenario.id: Mau pergi seharian. Gaya packing kamu…

answers.en: Use a checklist, with spares packed too
answers.id: Pakai checklist, termasuk barang cadangan

answers.en: Pack the essentials, figure out the rest as we go
answers.id: Bawa yg penting, sisanya sambil jalan

scenario.en: Sleep, meals, play. Your child's daily rhythm…
scenario.id: Tidur, makan, main. Ritme harian si kecil…

answers.en: Roughly the same times each day
answers.id: Jamnya kurang lebih sama tiap hari

answers.en: Follows my child's rhythm; each day can differ
answers.id: Ngikutin ritme anak, tiap hari bisa beda

scenario.id: Waktunya main. Siapa yg pilih aktivitas?

answers.en: I choose and set up the activity
answers.id: Aku pilih & siapin aktivitasnya

answers.en: I set out options; my child chooses
answers.id: Aku siapin pilihan, anak yg tentuin

scenario.en: Your child picks a superhero costume + boots for a family event. You…
scenario.id: Ke acara keluarga, anak pilih kostum superhero + boots. Kamu…

answers.en: Choose an outfit that suits the event
answers.id: Pilihkan baju yg cocok utk acaranya

answers.en: Let them wear their choice 😎
answers.id: Biarin dia pakai pilihannya 😎

scenario.en: Playtime's over. How do you approach cleanup?
scenario.id: Selesai main. Cara kamu ngajak beres-beres…

answers.en: Set a clear rule: after play, toys go back
answers.id: Pakai aturan: selesai main, beresin dulu

answers.en: Make cleanup inviting so they start on their own
answers.id: Bikin beres-beres menarik, biar dia mulai sendiri

scenario.en: A mall meltdown. Your usual first move…
scenario.id: Anak tantrum di mal. Kamu biasanya mulai dr…

answers.en: Crouch down: “You’re really upset, huh…”
answers.id: Jongkok, bilang: “Kamu kesel ya…”

answers.en: Give a hug and move somewhere calmer
answers.id: Peluk, ajak ke tempat yg lebih tenang

scenario.en: The block tower falls. Tears follow. Your first move…
scenario.id: Menara balok roboh, anak nangis. Respons awalmu…

answers.en: “That’s frustrating…” Hear their feelings first
answers.id: “Sebel ya…” Dengerin perasaannya dulu

answers.en: “Let’s rebuild.” Help put it back together
answers.id: “Yuk bangun lagi.” Bantu susun bareng

scenario.en: Your child seems sad at bedtime. You start with…
scenario.id: Mau tidur, anak kelihatan sedih. Kamu mulai dr…

answers.en: Ask gently and listen to their story
answers.id: Tanya pelan-pelan, dengerin ceritanya

answers.en: A long cuddle and their favorite blanket
answers.id: Peluk lama, ambilin selimut favorit

scenario.en: Your child eyes the tall slide. You…

answers.en: “Want to try?” I stay close to help
answers.id: “Coba yuk.” Aku jagain dr dekat

answers.en: Suggest the lower slide first
answers.id: Ajak ke yg lebih rendah dulu

scenario.en: Puddles after the rain. You choose…
scenario.id: Ada genangan habis hujan. Kamu pilih…

answers.en: A little splash; clothes can be washed 😄
answers.id: Main air sebentar, baju bisa dicuci 😄

answers.en: Take the dry path and stay comfy
answers.id: Cari jalan kering, tetap nyaman

answers.en: Encourage a hello while staying close
answers.id: Ajak kenalan, aku temenin dr dekat

answers.en: Let them stay close until they feel ready
answers.id: Biarin nempel dulu sampai dia siap
